name: Douglas C. Wood
bio:
Mr. Wood has worked over 40 years in the areas of cost of quality, office waste, root cause analysis, performance measurement. He has helped others with various ASQ certifications in quality auditing, management, and engineering. He has also taught auditing, Lean, Six Sigma, cost of quality, statistics, and failure modes and effects analysis. He has 5 ASQ certifications: CQE, CQA, CQPA, SSBB, and CMQ/OE.

He has published:
“The Certified Manager of Quality/ Organizational Excellence Handbook 5th Edition” by ASQ Quality Press
“The Executive Guide to Understanding and Implementing Quality Cost Programs: Reduce Operating Expenses and Increase Revenue” by ASQ Quality Press
“Principles of Quality Costs, Financial Measures for Strategic Implementation of Quality Management 4th Edition” by ASQ Quality Press

His firm DC Wood Consulting LLC has worked with clients in manufacturing, healthcare, and transactional businesses. The company's website is www.dcwoodconsulting.com.
